major.problem: The diagnostic-accuracy claim for actigraphy is stated without caveats.
major.why_it_matters: It is the central claim of the paper.
major.resolution: Qualify the claim and cite the contrasting replication.

evidence.quote: In contrast to Smith et al., actigraphy alone did not separate RBD from periodic limb movements.

summary: codex-review on claude-paper: the evidence bundle confirms the blind findings.
